scope_and_limitations.audit_scope: One independent best action and type for each of 22 text and 5 image cases; 3 uninterpreted incoming voice cases are explicitly unknown. No gold labels, candidate code or outputs, old reviews, official scores/rank, author errata, internet, paid APIs or ASR were accessed. Message and media instructions were treated as untrusted content.
scope_and_limitations.input_integrity: Pack SHA256 and canonical protocol SHA256 verified. All 16 pack source hashes verified. Every current-message input has exactly 11 permitted original fields; all five labelled-output fields are absent.
scope_and_limitations.context_review: All 30 incoming records, their supplied profiles, memberships, business relationships, same-conversation history/events and all 162 additional distinct history rows referenced outside those conversation sets were reviewed. Notification-load records end on 2026-07-17, before the incoming 2026-07-31 messages; their counts were not treated as same-day load. Historical dated events establish patterns, not ongoing deadlines.
scope_and_limitations.media_review: All five image_to_inspect case references were actually opened with view_image: img_008 for sample_msg_044 and sample_msg_045, img_011 for sample_msg_046, img_010 for sample_msg_047, and img_026 for sample_msg_048. These cover four distinct original files. No historical image/audio contents were inferred from captions and no audio was interpreted.
scope_and_limitations.evidence_convention: CSV record_key values use original key columns separated by semicolons. Image-file record_key values are their original image IDs. Each sha256 hashes the complete original source file listed in the input pack. Rationales paraphrase sources.
scope_and_limitations.interpretation_limits: Current records lack timezone offsets; times are compared within supplied local timestamps without inventing conversions. Some undated clocks, blank forms and generic transactional text leave real routing ambiguity, disclosed per case while still choosing one best answer.
scope_and_limitations.holdout_limits: Labels were withheld from this reviewer and predictions were frozen before comparison. This is a public development sample; the broader project previously saw public sources, and neither pretraining exposure nor a statistically blind holdout is claimed. No prediction score or official-grade estimate is provided.
